He encounters the following characters: *[[Thickshell]] the [[Crab]], who refers to Fablinix as "Fabmeister." *Mr. [[Treant]] *[[Muckvix]], who has a bio potion and anti-bio potion with memory restoring properties. *[[Verena]] *Mandraggy and his [[Mandragora]] family, Mandaddy, Manmommy, Mangreggy, Manpetey, Manbobby, and the Mandrakids. *[[Bloodsucker|Ms. Blood Suckah]], a [[:Category:Leeches|leech]] rapper. *[[Tonberry Kinq|The Tonberry "Kink"]] *Moblina, a female [[Moblin]] and [[White Mage]] who possesses an unknown spell and a spell of memory restoration. ===Year of the Bird appearance=== His first official appearance was in the Year of the Bird New Year's Event, where he and other [[Goblin Rider]]s dug up cards in the area. ===Starlight Celebration appearance=== Fablinix once again aided the [[Goblin Rider]]s in digging up cards during the [[starlight Celebration 2010]] event. He appeared in [[South Gustaberg]]. Fablinix had his own dialogue separate from the other [[Goblin Rider]]s: "This chocobo riding is more painful than it looks. I think I'm starting to chafe."
"Would somebody explain to me why we're collecting these things again?"
"I wonder how much I could get for this at the local pawnshop..."
"Lookin' for cards in all the wrong places.♪"
"Digging holes in the dirt... Yeah this is my idea of excitement" ===Adventurer Appreciation appearances=== *In [[Adventurer Appreciation Campaign 2012]], many [[Aspiring Adventurer]]s had lost copies of stories written by Fablinix. The player had to check random ???s around the cities to find the missing stories. *Fablinix appeared sometimes in [[Port Windurst]], [[Bastok Mines]] and [[Northern San d'Oria]] during [[Adventurer Appreciation Campaign 2012]].
